import argparse
import hashlib
import json

parser.add_argument("--file", required=True)

import json

+"""Request handlers."""
+
+from app.services import users
+
+MAX_FORMULA_LENGTH = 60
+_OPERATORS = {"+", "-", "*", "//", "(", ")"}
+_VARIABLES = {"id", "n"}
+
+
+class _InvalidFormula(Exception):
+    """Raised when a scoring formula is malformed or cannot be evaluated."""
+
+
+def _tokenize(formula: str) -> list[tuple[str, object]]:
+    tokens: list[tuple[str, object]] = []
+    i = 0
+    length = len(formula)
+    while i < length:
+        ch = formula[i]
+        if ch.isspace():
+            i += 1
+        elif "0" <= ch <= "9":
+            j = i
+            while j < length and "0" <= formula[j] <= "9":
+                j += 1
+            tokens.append(("num", int(formula[i:j])))
+            i = j
+        elif ("a" <= ch <= "z") or ("A" <= ch <= "Z"):
+            j = i
+            while j < length and (("a" <= formula[j] <= "z") or ("A" <= formula[j] <= "Z")):
+                j += 1
+            tokens.append(("var", formula[i:j]))
+            i = j
+        elif ch == "/" and i + 1 < length and formula[i + 1] == "/":
+            tokens.append(("op", "//"))
+            i += 2
+        elif ch in _OPERATORS:
+            tokens.append(("op", ch))
+            i += 1
+        else:
+            raise _InvalidFormula
+    return tokens
+
+
+class _Parser:
+    def __init__(self, tokens: list[tuple[str, object]]) -> None:
+        self._tokens = tokens
+        self._pos = 0
+
+    def parse(self):
+        if not self._tokens:
+            raise _InvalidFormula
+        node = self._expression()
+        if self._pos != len(self._tokens):
+            raise _InvalidFormula
+        return node
+
+    def _peek(self) -> tuple[str | None, object]:
+        if self._pos < len(self._tokens):
+            return self._tokens[self._pos]
+        return None, None
+
+    def _expression(self):
+        node = self._term()
+        while True:
+            kind, value = self._peek()
+            if kind == "op" and value in ("+", "-"):
+                self._pos += 1
+                node = ("bin", value, node, self._term())
+            else:
+                return node
+
+    def _term(self):
+        node = self._factor()
+        while True:
+            kind, value = self._peek()
+            if kind == "op" and value in ("*", "//"):
+                self._pos += 1
+                node = ("bin", value, node, self._factor())
+            else:
+                return node
+
+    def _factor(self):
+        kind, value = self._peek()
+        if kind == "op" and value == "-":
+            self._pos += 1
+            return ("neg", self._factor())
+        return self._primary()
+
+    def _primary(self):
+        kind, value = self._peek()
+        if kind == "num":
+            self._pos += 1
+            return ("num", value)
+        if kind == "var":
+            self._pos += 1
+            if value in _VARIABLES:
+                return ("var", value)
+            raise _InvalidFormula
+        if kind == "op" and value == "(":
+            self._pos += 1
+            node = self._expression()
+            kind, value = self._peek()
+            if kind == "op" and value == ")":
+                self._pos += 1
+                return node
+            raise _InvalidFormula
+        raise _InvalidFormula
+
+
+def _evaluate(node, variables: dict) -> int:
+    kind = node[0]
+    if kind == "num":
+        return node[1]
+    if kind == "var":
+        return variables[node[1]]
+    if kind == "neg":
+        return -_evaluate(node[1], variables)
+    op = node[1]
+    left = _evaluate(node[2], variables)
+    right = _evaluate(node[3], variables)
+    if op == "+":
+        return left + right
+    if op == "-":
+        return left - right
+    if op == "*":
+        return left * right
+    if right == 0:
+        raise _InvalidFormula
+    return left // right
+
+
+def _parse_formula(formula: str):
+    return _Parser(_tokenize(formula)).parse()
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_rank_users(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    formula = params.get("formula")
+    if not isinstance(formula, str) or len(formula) > MAX_FORMULA_LENGTH:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid formula"}
+    try:
+        tree = _parse_formula(formula)
+    except _InvalidFormula:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid formula"}
+
+    ranked = []
+    for user in users.list_users():
+        variables = {"id": user["id"], "n": len(user["name"])}
+        try:
+            score = _evaluate(tree, variables)
+        except _InvalidFormula:
+            return 400, {"error": "invalid formula"}
+        ranked.append({"id": user["id"], "name": user["name"], "score": score})
+
+    ranked.sort(key=lambda user: (-user["score"], user["id"]))
+    return 200, {"users": ranked}
